_what: The score half of the 30-second fixture (thirty-second.fountain). The screenplay is written, broken into these three shots, a picture sequence is made over them, each shot gets footage, and the scene is scored: an accepted emotional arc, one generated cue and two uploaded stems, bounced, approved and conformed into the final movie. tests/music-e2e.test.js runs it twice through the MCP tools: once with no DAW, once through Ableton (push, pull plan, and the portable package back).

shots.description: Rain on the diner window; MAYA wipes the counter in slow circles.
MAYA looks up at the door. It is still shut; the bell has not moved.
The sign settles to a steady red. MAYA sets down the cloth.

arc.label: closing time
arc.rationale: 1A: rain, an empty diner, slow circles on the counter — tired, not yet uneasy.

arc.label: someone is there
arc.rationale: 1B: she answers a door that has not opened; the bell has not moved.

arc.label: she decides
arc.rationale: 1C: the sign steadies and she puts the cloth down — the unease settles into resolve.

generate.prompt: sparse low strings under rain, uneasy, resolving
